response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT st.healtheval AS healtheval, SUM(s.scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM scans s JOIN sites st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY st.healtheval), m AS (SELECT healtheval, total_scans, avg_gb_per_min, AVG(avg_gb_per_min) OVER () AS mean_of_avgs FROM g) SELECT healtheval, total_scans, avg_gb_per_min, avg_gb_per_min - mean_of_avgs AS diff_from_mean FROM m WHERE mean_of_avgs IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: A scan with spanmin = 0 is treated as a missing ratio (NULLIF avoids divide-by-zero). Scans with NULL gbsize or spanmin are excluded from the average ratio, but their scancount still counts toward the total.
Sites with a NULL healtheval form their own group and are included in the mean of the status-level averages.
The mean of the status-level averages is the unweighted mean across status groups whose average is not null. If that mean is NULL, no rows are returned.
